content.text:
Updated the package to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md`, including line-numbered parser errors, last-record-wins deduplication, and the ranking, per-group rate, and streak rules in sections 8–10. Corrected the README’s `conversions_in_window` entry and added `daily_conversion_counts`.

Added regression tests for `None` values in conversion rates, duplicate session IDs, and other specification edge cases. All 15 tests pass with `python -m pytest -q`.
